record.context_brief: quadratic width bound for first tangent-cone Betti number
record.original_question: If Gamma is a numerical semigroup and width(Gamma) is the difference between its largest and smallest minimal generators, is the first Betti number of the associated graded ring G_Gamma always bounded above by binom(width(Gamma)+1, 2)?

evidence.quote: Problem 9 ([HS14, Conjecture 2.1]). Let Γ be a numerical semigroup, then b1(GΓ ) 6 ( width(Γ)+1 2 ).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Gamma \subseteq \mathbb{N}$ be a numerical semigroup, that is, a cofinite submonoid of $(\mathbb{N},+)$ containing $0$. Write the (unique) minimal system of generators of $\Gamma$ as $n_1 < n_2 < \cdots < n_e$, and define the width of $\Gamma$ by
$$\mathrm{width}(\Gamma) = n_e - n_1.$$
Fix a field $k$, and let $k[\Gamma] = k[t^{n_1}, \ldots, t^{n_e}] \subseteq k[t]$ be the associated numerical semigroup ring, with maximal ideal $\mathfrak{m} = (t^{n_1}, \ldots, t^{n_e})$. Let
$$G_\Gamma = \mathrm{gr}_{\mathfrak{m}}(k[\Gamma]) = \bigoplus_{i \ge 0} \mathfrak{m}^i / \mathfrak{m}^{i+1}$$
be the associated graded ring (the coordinate ring of the tangent cone), regarded as a standard graded $k$-algebra. Let $b_1(G_\Gamma)$ denote the first Betti number of $G_\Gamma$ as a graded module over a polynomial ring surjecting onto $G_\Gamma$, i.e. the minimal number of generators of the defining ideal of $G_\Gamma$.

Prove or disprove: for every numerical semigroup $\Gamma$,
$$b_1(G_\Gamma) \;\le\; \binom{\mathrm{width}(\Gamma)+1}{2}.$$
artifact.category_tag: numerical semigroup rings and tangent cones
artifact.status_search_result: The bound is a conjecture of Herzog and Stamate (2014) on the first Betti number of the tangent cone of a numerical semigroup ring in terms of its width. It is listed as an open problem in recent surveys of open problems on numerical semigroups, and no proof or counterexample appears in the available literature.

status_evidence.title: Betti numbers for numerical semigroup rings (Stamate survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discusses Herzog-Stamate conjectures (Conjectures 2.1 and 2.4) on the magnitude of Betti numbers of numerical semigroup rings and their tangent cones.
status_evidence.claim: The width-squared bound is stated as a conjecture and remains unresolved in the survey.

status_evidence.title: Open problems on numerical semigroups (arXiv:2406.00790)
status_evidence.snippet: Lists the Herzog-Stamate inequality b_1(G_Gamma) <= binom(width(Gamma)+1, 2) as Problem 9.
status_evidence.claim: The inequality is presented as an open problem.
